# HubSpot

> HubSpot is a customer platform that combines CRM, marketing, sales, service, content, operations, commerce, and AI tools.

HubSpot serves businesses of all sizes with a unified platform for managing customer data, automating go-to-market work, and supporting the full customer lifecycle. Its ecosystem includes product documentation, developer APIs, academy courses, a knowledge base, and extensive educational content.

## Core Platform & Products
- [HubSpot Homepage](https://www.hubspot.com/): Main overview of HubSpot’s customer platform, products, pricing, and business solutions.
- [CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm): Free and paid CRM software for contacts, companies, deals, and customer activity.
- [Marketing Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing): Marketing automation, email, forms, campaigns, and lead generation software.
- [Sales Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales): Sales software for pipeline management, prospecting, meetings, and sales automation.
- [Service Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service): Customer service software for ticketing, help desk, knowledge base, and support automation.
- [Content Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content): Content marketing and CMS tools for websites, landing pages, and content operations.
- [Operations Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/operations): Data sync, automation, and process orchestration tools for operations teams.
- [Commerce Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/commerce): Payments, invoices, subscriptions, quotes, and commerce automation tools.

## AI & Platform Features
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence): Overview of HubSpot AI features, assistants, and automation across the platform.
- [Breeze](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/breeze): HubSpot’s AI layer for content generation, insights, and workflow assistance.
- [Smart CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/ai-crm): AI-powered CRM experience with unified customer data and contextual insights.
- [Customer Platform](https://www.hubspot.com/products/customer-platform): Overview of HubSpot’s connected platform spanning marketing, sales, and service.
- [App Marketplace](https://ecosystem.hubspot.com/marketplace/apps): Integrations and apps that extend HubSpot with third-party tools and services.

## Product Documentation & Knowledge Base
- [HubSpot Knowledge Base](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/): Official product documentation and how-to articles for HubSpot users.
- [Get Started](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/get-started): Introductory setup guidance for new HubSpot accounts and users.
- [CRM Setup](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/account): Account, settings, and CRM configuration documentation.
- [Marketing Software Docs](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/marketing-email): Documentation for email, forms, automation, and marketing tools.
- [Sales Software Docs](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/records): Documentation for contacts, companies, deals, and sales workflows.
- [Service Software Docs](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/help-desk): Documentation for help desk, tickets, inbox, and support tools.
- [CMS & Website Docs](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/website-pages): Documentation for website pages, landing pages, and content publishing.
- [Reports & Analytics Docs](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/reports): Documentation for dashboards, reports, attribution, and analytics.

## Developer Platform
- [HubSpot Developers](https://developers.hubspot.com/): Developer portal for APIs, apps, CMS development, and platform guides.
- [API Reference](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/overview): Overview of HubSpot APIs, authentication, and platform capabilities.
- [CRM API](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/overview): APIs for contacts, companies, deals, tickets, and custom objects.
- [Marketing API](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/marketing/marketing-events): Marketing-related APIs for events and campaign-connected workflows.
- [CMS Development Docs](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/cms): Documentation for building themes, modules, and websites on HubSpot CMS.
- [Webhook API](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/webhooks): Webhook subscriptions for receiving HubSpot event notifications.
- [OAuth Apps](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/legacy-apps/authentication/oauth-quickstart-guide): OAuth guide for building public integrations with HubSpot.
- [Developer Changelog](https://developers.hubspot.com/changelog): Updates and release notes for HubSpot developer products and APIs.

## Academy & Learning
- [HubSpot Academy](https://academy.hubspot.com/): Free courses, certifications, and training for HubSpot and business skills.
- [Academy Certifications](https://academy.hubspot.com/certification-overview): Overview of available HubSpot certifications and learning paths.
- [Inbound Certification](https://academy.hubspot.com/courses/inbound): Training on inbound methodology, lead generation, and customer engagement.
- [Marketing Software Certification](https://academy.hubspot.com/courses/marketing-hub-software): Product training for using HubSpot marketing tools effectively.
- [Sales Software Certification](https://academy.hubspot.com/courses/sales-hub-software): Product training for managing pipelines and sales processes in HubSpot.
- [Service Software Certification](https://academy.hubspot.com/courses/service-hub-software): Product training for support, ticketing, and customer service workflows.
- [CMS for Developers](https://academy.hubspot.com/courses/cms-for-developers): Training for developers building websites and modules on HubSpot CMS.

## Support & Community
- [Help Center](https://help.hubspot.com/): Support entry point for documentation, troubleshooting, and customer assistance.
- [HubSpot Community](https://community.hubspot.com/): Community forums for product questions, peer support, and best practices.
- [Contact HubSpot Support](https://help.hubspot.com/contact-us): Support contact options for HubSpot customers and users.
- [System Status](https://status.hubspot.com/): Real-time status information for HubSpot products and services.
- [Ideas Forum](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/HubSpot-Ideas/idb-p/HubSpot_Ideas): Product feedback board for feature requests and improvement suggestions.

## Blog & Educational Content
- [HubSpot Blog](https://blog.hubspot.com/): Main blog covering marketing, sales, service, websites, and business growth.
- [Marketing Blog](https://blog.hubspot.com/marketing): Articles on SEO, content, email marketing, and demand generation.
- [Sales Blog](https://blog.hubspot.com/sales): Articles on prospecting, pipeline management, and sales strategy.
- [Service Blog](https://blog.hubspot.com/service): Articles on customer support, retention, and service operations.
- [Website Blog](https://blog.hubspot.com/website): Articles on websites, CMS, UX, and conversion optimization.
- [The Hustle](https://thehustle.co/): HubSpot-owned business and tech publication focused on trends and analysis.
- [Research & Reports](https://www.hubspot.com/resources): Resource library with guides, templates, and business research.
